column1: # Arithmetic with the special values, see docs/spec/special_values.md. Not run by the tests yet.
# Columns as in calculation.tsv: target, expression or statement, operands a and b, -, expected. The target is
# type[start value] of the result field of `result = expression.` or of an assignment operator or ADD on it, or
# DATA for `DATA(result) = expression.` and for CONV and EXACT assigned to such a declaration, whose expected
# result is type:value. EXC:<class>,<value>: the exception is raised and the result field holds <value> afterwards.
# DUMP:<runtime error> cannot be caught; NOEND: the statement does not finish in any practical time.
# Special values are written as in special_conversion.tsv; *{n} stands for n asterisks.
